description: This file defines the GrainProperties class and related types for managing grain metadata in Orleans. It includes classes for representing grain properties, well-known property keys, and providers for populating such properties from attributes and service providers.

classes.name: GrainProperties
classes.description: Represents properties of a grain type, with methods for string representation.

classes.name: WellKnownGrainTypeProperties
classes.description: Provides constants for well-known grain property keys.

classes.name: IGrainPropertiesProvider
classes.description: Interface for classes that supply grain properties.

classes.name: IGrainPropertiesProviderAttribute
classes.description: Interface for attributes that provide grain properties.

classes.name: AttributeGrainPropertiesProvider
classes.description: Default implementation of IGrainPropertiesProvider that populates properties from attributes.

classes.name: AttributeGrainBindingsProvider
classes.description: Implementation that populates grain bindings from attributes implementing IGrainBindingsProviderAttribute.

methods.name: GrainProperties
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a collection of properties.

methods.name: ToDetailedString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation of the grain properties.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Populates grain properties from attributes or provider.
